read_only_findings: EntersWithReplacements.applyGlobal enumerates sources from partially updated battlefield/graveyard while MoveCollection iterates. A new battlefield provider can affect later coentrants, and a graveyard provider removed first is lost too early.
applyOnEntry returns when no registered CardDefinition exists, suppressing external replacement effects on copied token/face-down values.
StackResolver skips all entry counters when cardDef is null or castFaceDown, conflating printed self replacement text with global effects.
Single and collection effect entry skip applyOnEntry entirely for face-down entries; concealed own text must be suppressed without suppressing external effects.
